021import net.tnemc.core.TNECore;
022import net.tnemc.core.account.Account;
023import net.tnemc.core.account.holdings.HoldingsEntry;
024import net.tnemc.core.transaction.Transaction;
025import net.tnemc.core.utils.Identifier;
026import net.tnemc.plugincore.PluginCore;
027
028import java.io.DataInput;
029import java.io.IOException;
030import java.math.BigDecimal;
031import java.util.Collections;
032import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
033import java.util.Map;
034import java.util.Optional;
035import java.util.UUID;
036import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
037import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
038import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;
039
040/**
041 * Syncs balance changes between servers.
042 *
043 * <p>Each message carries the change (delta), not the resulting balance. Every server adds it to
044 * its own current balance under the balance lock, so changes made on several servers at once all
045 * count instead of overwriting each other. Each change has an ID and is applied at most once.</p>
046 */
047public final class BalanceHandler {
048
049  private static final int REMEMBERED_CHANGES = 10_000;
050  private static final ThreadLocal<Boolean> APPLYING_REMOTE = ThreadLocal.withInitial(()->false);
051  private static final Map<UUID, Boolean> APPLIED = Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>() {
052    @Override
053    protected boolean removeEldestEntry(final Map.Entry<UUID, Boolean> eldest) {
054
055      return size() > REMEMBERED_CHANGES;
056    }
057  });
058
059  private BalanceHandler() {
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * @return true while this thread applies a change received from another server; such a change
064   * must not be sent back out.
065   */
066  public static boolean applyingRemote() {
067
068    return APPLYING_REMOTE.get();
069  }
070
071  public static void send(final String identifier, final String name, final String region, final UUID currency,
072                          final Identifier handler, final BigDecimal delta) {
073
074    if(!TNECore.syncEnabled() || delta.signum() == 0) {
075      return;
076    }
077
078    final String change = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
079    RedisSync.publish(RedisSync.BALANCE, out->{
080      out.writeUTF(change);
081      out.writeUTF(identifier);
082      out.writeUTF(name);
083      out.writeUTF(region);
084      out.writeUTF(currency.toString());
085      out.writeUTF(handler.asID());
086      out.writeUTF(delta.toPlainString());
087    });
088  }
089
090  static void handle(final DataInput in) throws IOException {
091
092    final UUID change = UUID.fromString(in.readUTF());
093    final String accountID = in.readUTF();
094    final String accountName = in.readUTF();
095    final String region = in.readUTF();
096    final UUID currency = UUID.fromString(in.readUTF());
097    final Identifier handler = Identifier.fromID(in.readUTF());
098    final BigDecimal delta = new BigDecimal(in.readUTF());
099
100    if(APPLIED.containsKey(change)) {
101      return;
102    }
103
104    try {
105      if(TNECore.eco().currency().find(currency)
106              .map(value->value.type().name().equals("virtual") && !value.type().supportsItems()).orElse(false)) {
107        //Virtual balances have no player-thread state; serialise them directly without a tick delay.
108        apply(change, accountID, accountName, region, currency, handler, delta);
109        return;
110      }
111      //The reader advances its stream cursor only after the owning player thread applied the delta.
112      TNECore.instance().runPlayerTask(UUID.fromString(accountID),
113              ()->apply(change, accountID, accountName, region, currency, handler, delta)).get(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
114    } catch(final InterruptedException interrupted) {
115      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
116      throw new SyncApplyException(interrupted);
117    } catch(final ExecutionException | TimeoutException | RuntimeException failure) {
118      throw new SyncApplyException(failure);
119    }
120  }
121
122  private static void apply(final UUID change, final String accountID, final String accountName, final String region, final UUID currency,
123                            final Identifier handler, final BigDecimal delta) {
124
125    synchronized(Transaction.BALANCE_LOCK) {
126      if(APPLIED.containsKey(change)) {
127        return;
128      }
129      Optional<Account> account = TNECore.eco().account().findAccount(accountID);
130      if(account.isEmpty()) {
131        account = TNECore.eco().account().createAccount(accountID, accountName).getAccount();
132      }
133      if(account.isEmpty()) {
134        throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to create account for synced balance " + accountID);
135      }
136
137      final BigDecimal current = account.get().getHoldingsTotal(region, currency, handler);
138      APPLYING_REMOTE.set(true);
139      try {
140        if(!account.get().setHoldings(new HoldingsEntry(region, currency, current.add(delta), handler), handler)) {
141          throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to apply synced balance to " + accountID);
142        }
143        APPLIED.put(change, Boolean.TRUE);
144      } finally {
145        APPLYING_REMOTE.set(false);
146      }
147    }
148  }
149
150  /** Transient dispatch/application failures must reconnect and retry, rather than skip the entry. */
151  static final class SyncApplyException extends RuntimeException {
152
153    private SyncApplyException(final Exception cause) {
154
155      super("Unable to apply Redis balance update", cause);
156    }
157  }
158}
